payload.authorizing_milestone: AGENTS.md T4 autonomous-search strategy reset, 2026-09-16. This is the zero-oracle actual-sampler probability/rank line of that milestone. It fits nothing and authorizes no scored launch.

eligible_at_or_above_15_primitives.method: rule of three after zero successes

declared_support.note: composing up to eight modules USES the support AGENTS.md already declares; it does not widen it. v0's own three-module cap is left in place and its lane is untouched, because v1 and v2.1 were both harmed by replacing working v0 mechanisms rather than adding beside them.

measurements: dependency-region decomposition of the 77 exact teacher routes
per-family median created versus changed-original atoms
score distribution by program size within the gap cells
eligible rate by realized program size, from each benchmark root
density of eligible large constructions applied directly to each root
payload.post_hoc_disclosure: the size bands, the 15-primitive threshold and the builder-family set were all chosen after inspecting this corpus. They describe the measurement and must not be read as preregistered. The lane gate below is the prospective part and was frozen before the lane existed.
prohibitions: no Modal launch and no live-run access
no modification of synthesize_dynamic_program or any v0/v1/v2.1 lane
no change to any endpoint gate, executor semantic or declared support

prospective_lane_gate.applies_to: the deep constructive proposal lane, not yet implemented
prospective_lane_gate.claim_boundary: this gate measures ACCESS to the region, not docking value within it. Section 7 of the strategy report measured distance-to-best against score-gap at Spearman 0.12 on PARP1, so structure does not predict utility and eligible large constructions still require real docking feedback to be aimed.
prospective_lane_gate.held_out_rule: evaluate on a cell whose target was held out of anything fitted, using the leave-one-target-out folds already frozen in configs/t4_proposal_prior_dataset_v1.json
prospective_lane_gate.kill: if the held-out eligible rate at >=15 primitives stays at or below 0.0142, the reachability hypothesis is refuted for this mechanism. Drop the lane and report the negative result; do not widen the sampler or relax a gate.
must_also_hold: no endpoint gate is relaxed: similarity, QED and SA thresholds unchanged
no program exceeds 32 primitives or 8 blocks
v0's shallow lane is byte-unchanged and its candidate law is unaffected
prospective_lane_gate.pass: eligible rate at >=15 primitives is at least 0.05 on the held-out cell, which is roughly a quarter of the region's own historical density and 3.5x the upper bound on the current sampler

payload.question: Bounded T4 search reaches a median of 5.5 primitives while the docking value from the benchmark root lives at 15-22. Is that a capability limit or a reachability limit, and what would have to change to close it?
